name: Regulations.gov API
tagline: Search and retrieve U.S. federal regulations, dockets, and public comments.
description: Official U.S. federal API for searching and retrieving regulatory documents, dockets, public comments, and related metadata from Regulations.gov. Supports discovery of rulemaking materials, comment submissions tracking, and bulk access to government regulatory data for research and compliance applications.

auth.details: API key via X-Api-Key header; free self-serve signup through api.data.gov

pricing.free_tier_limits: api.data.gov standard free tier (typically 1,000 req/hour); confirm on signup

rate_limits: Subject to api.data.gov rate limits; exact published limits may vary
use_cases: search federal regulatory documents by keyword or agency
retrieve a docket and its related documents
list public comments on a proposed rule
get metadata for a specific regulation document
monitor new rulemaking activity by agency
